power.title: 01  USB-C INPUT / ESD
notes: R1/R2 5.1k: USB-C sink detection in either orientation; no USB-PD negotiation.
D1 clamps fast ESD; C1/C2 locally bypass VBUS. Keep the ESD return short.
Power: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Data: D1 -> R38/R39 -> GPIO19/20 (sheet 4).

power.title: 02  SINGLE-CELL 4.2 V CHARGER
notes: U3: constant-current then constant-voltage charge. C3 input / C4 battery bypass.
R30 initially DNP. Fit after cell/polarity/rating checks; verify charge and heat.

power.title: 03  CELL CONNECTOR / PROTECTION
notes: U4 monitors the cell; opposing Q3 MOSFETs interrupt its return during faults.
R4/C5: tau = 100R x 100nF = 10 us; ideal fc = 1/(2*pi*RC) = 15.9 kHz.
R5 is the sense-input resistor. B_MINUS != GND: do not bypass Q3.

power.title: 04  SOURCE SHARING / CONTROL-ONLY SWITCH
notes: USB: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Battery: B_PLUS -> Q1 -> SYS_IN.
R6 pulls Q1 gate low without USB; USB raises its gate to isolate the cell path.
SW1 ON grounds LED_GATE; OFF grounds SYS_EN. R7/R41 are pull-ups.
Contacts carry control current only: 4.2 V / 100k = 42 uA per grounded pull-up.
OFF disables loads; charging/protection are still connected. Q5/R41: sheet 4.

power.title: 05  3.3 V LDO / LOCAL BULK CAPACITANCE
notes: U5 reuses the owned linear regulator; C7/C10 support input/output transients.
Heat ~= (VSYS - 3.3 V)*Iavg; example (4.7 - 3.3)*0.25 A = 0.35 W.
Droop ~= deltaI*deltat/Ceff + ESR step; 100mA*10us/10uF = 0.10 V.
This is brief charge support, not guaranteed brownout prevention; DC bias lowers C.
Verify rail sag + temperature. A 600 mA rating is not an enclosed thermal guarantee.

power.title: 06  BATTERY ADC / OFF-STATE ISOLATION
notes: VADC = VBAT*10/(30+10) = VBAT/4; 4.2 V -> 1.05 V; divider current 105 uA.
Q4 blocks cell-to-ADC drive when +3V3 is off. R16 discharges the node.
ON: Rth ~= 30k||10k = 7.5k; 1nF gives tau 7.5us, fc 21.2kHz (ideal).
OFF: R16*C29 = 10us. Small C prioritizes safe discharge, not 5s report filtering.
J2 firmware uses calibrated mV x4 + averaging/EMA. Verify actual rail transitions.

mcu.title: 07  ESP32-S3FH4R2 / PIN CONTRACT
notes: 4 MB embedded flash + 2 MB quad PSRAM; initial build leaves PSRAM disabled.
Phone GPS/IMU -> BLE -> U1 -> LoRa. No separate GPS/IMU hardware added.
GPIO0 BOOT/cancel; 1 buzzer; 2 ADC; 8/9 LoRa interrupt/reset.
GPIO10/11/12/13 NSS/MOSI/SCK/MISO; 19/20 USB D-/D+; 48 RGB.
Exposed pad 57 is GND and a thermal path; inspect the hidden solder joint.

mcu.title: 08  LOCAL BYPASS / RF SUPPLY FEED
notes: L1 + C11/C12/C13 feed/bypass VDD_RF; C14 supports main rail; C15/C16 serve CPU/RTC; C21/C22 analog supply.
C17/C20 bypass internally supplied VDD_SPI: do not tie it to +3V3. Ideal |XC|=1/(2*pi*f*C); real ESR/ESL and placement matter.

mcu.title: 09  RESET / BOOT / STRAPS
notes: R8*C33 = 10k*1uF = 10 ms. EN(t)=VDD*(1-exp(-t/tau)); 63% at tau.
Reset release depends on the input threshold and supply ramp, not exactly 10 ms.
R34 holds GPIO0 high; R35/R36 hold GPIO45/46 low while straps are sampled.
Buttons on sheet 4: hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT to enter download.

mcu.title: 10  40 MHz CLOCK / INITIAL LOADS
notes: CL ~= C24*C25/(C24+C25)+Cstray = 6pF + assumed 4pF = 10pF.
12pF is an available starting pair; actual stray capacitance is unmeasured.
R9 22R damps/limits drive. It differs from Espressif's 24nH starting guidance.
Measure startup, frequency and drive/harmonics; these parts are not tuned yet.

mcu.title: 11  2.4 GHz MATCHING / ANTENNA — STARTING VALUES
notes: CLC: 1.5pF / 2.4nH / 1.5pF. Antenna network: 1.2pF series / 2.7nH shunt / 3.3nH series. ANT1 pin2 is intentionally NC.
At 2.4GHz: XL(2.4nH)=36.2R; |XC|(1.5pF)=44.2R (ideal examples, not proof of a 50R match).
Tune with actual board/enclosure/body loading. Keep antenna no-metal area clear; LoRa uses a separate 433MHz antenna.

io.title: 12  Ra-02 / FILTERED SUPPLY / SPI
notes: FB1 + C26/C27 isolate/bypass radio supply; ferrite Z depends on frequency.
R11 33R damps SCK; R37 10k keeps NSS high/unselected at startup.
433MHz / SF9 / BW125kHz / CR4/5 / 17dBm / sync0x34.
Fit 433MHz antenna before TX. Hand-solder bottom module after top reflow.

io.title: 13  RGB POWER / DATA LEVEL TRANSLATION
notes: Q5 switches raw SYS_IN; R41 pulls gate off. U6 translates 3.3V GPIO48 to LED_PWR.
C34/C35 bypass both U6 rails; C28 bypasses LED. R13 damps; R42/R43 pull data low.
0 bit H/L=300/1000ns; 1 bit=700/600ns; reset >=300us LOW (J2 RMT profile).
LED1 initially DNP: qualify exact stock voltage/pinout/current. No LED power boost.

io.title: 14  ACTIVE BUZZER / NPN DRIVER
notes: Load current: +3V3 -> BZ1 -> Q2 -> GND. GPIO1 supplies base drive.
IB ~= (3.3-0.8)/330 = 7.58mA (assumed VBE). Conservative example:
(2.4-1.2)/330=3.64mA; forced gain10 suggests ~36mA load.
R14 holds OFF; D3 handles inductive transients. Verify actual buzzer current.

io.title: CONTROLS / USB SERIES DAMPING
notes: SW2 grounds MCU_EN; SW3 grounds GPIO0 for boot/cancel.
R38/R39 22R reduce USB edge ringing near the MCU; not a voltage divider.
PCB differential geometry and stackup still need impedance confirmation.

io.title: 15  TEST ACCESS / PROTECTED GROUND
notes: Use TP1/GND as system reference; do not short B_MINUS to GND via instruments.

HOW TO READ / COST AND QUALITY
notes: Same global net name = same electrical connection, across all sheets.
Cross on a pin = deliberate no-connect. DNP = staged omission.
Text/boxes/arrows explain the circuit; they are not electrical wires.
Equations use nominal values and stated assumptions; measure real behavior.
Reuse suitable stock. Every added part should earn its cost and board space.
No new electrical components were added for this learning layout.
